data.name: Rootwoven
data.detailed_description:
NOTE: ROOTWOVEN is only on start of it's journey. We're developing the game with support of community. Your messages, game time and input allows us to make the game we dream about. Thank you for support and understanding. We hope our transparency through the whole development, will give you as much joy as we have. We're starting Kickstarter soon, join us early to get access to new content first! 

ROOTWOVEN is a dark-fantasy mystery visual novel built around natural-language investigation.

Instead of choosing from a fixed dialogue menu, you type what you actually want to ask, accuse, hide, confess, or provoke.

At the Academy, every conversation is a thread. Pull the right one and secrets loosen. Pull the wrong one and people close ranks.

You are not chatting into a void. ROOTWOVEN’s world is hand-authored: its characters, clues, loyalties, quests, and consequences are built to react to the way you investigate. Trust is earned. Suspicion spreads. What you learn — and what you reveal — changes how the story moves around you.

INVESTIGATE IN YOUR OWN WORDS

Question characters naturally instead of clicking pre-written lines. Press for detail. Test contradictions. Change the subject. Deflect. Charm. Threaten. Confess. Stay silent when silence is smarter.

REACTIVE CHARACTERS, NOT DIALOGUE DISPENSERS

The people around you remember what you ask, what you hide, how you push, and whether they should trust you. Relationships can deepen, fracture, or curdle into rivalry and fear.

A MYSTERY YOU UNRAVEL, NOT JUST WATCH

Follow rumors, buried histories, private griefs, and dangerous loyalties through a story shaped by discovery and consequence. The truth is there — but not everyone wants you to reach it.

ROMANCE IS POSSIBLE, NEVER REQUIRED

Every major relationship can shift in its own direction. Friendship, dependence, rivalry, desire, resentment, devotion: how close you become is part of the story, not a side menu.

A HAND-AUTHORED DESCENT THROUGH ONE SCHOOL YEAR

From your first evening at the Academy to the choices that define your ending, ROOTWOVEN follows one long descent through secrecy, ritual, intimacy, and becoming.

FEATURES

• Natural-language conversations inside authored narrative scenes
• Mystery-driven investigation with clue chains, secrets, and contradictions
• Characters with memory, mood, boundaries, and relationship logic
• Major choices that alter alliances, scenes, and endings
• Optional romance routes woven into a larger dark-fantasy story
• A hand-authored world designed to respond to the questions you ask

Wishlist and follow ROOTWOVEN on Steam, follow us on social media. Kickstarter campaign starting soon

data.short_description: Type what you want to say in a dark-fantasy visual novel where the Academy listens back. Investigate secrets, question suspicious classmates, and shape trust, clues, and consequences through natural-language dialogue.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 1.8 GHz Dual-Core CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.0 64-bit
  • Processor: 1.8 GHz Dual-Core CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Character responses generated by LLM's might contain sexual content if user strongly tries to drive conversation, but it's not intentional and we try to block it.
